result:
The profile page now has a "Change Password" button next to "Update Profile" that opens a drawer with current password, new password and confirm new password fields. Nothing was run, as you asked, so the code and the new tests are untested.

- **Wrong current password:** the mock API (`PATCH /users/password`) compares the hash of the current password with the stored one and answers 400 with "Current password is incorrect". The user sees it as the standard error toast and the drawer stays open. I used 400 instead of 401 because the API client redirects to the login page on 401.
- **Client-side checks:** the new password must be at least 5 characters (same as registration), the two new entries must match, and the new password must differ from the current one. The mock API also enforces the minimum length.
- **Success:** a "Password Changed" toast appears and the drawer closes. The user stays logged in.

The new code is in `features/users/api/change-password.ts` and `features/users/components/change-password.tsx`, with the handler added to `testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts` and the button wired into `app/routes/app/profile.tsx`. I also added `features/users/components/__tests__/change-password.test.tsx` covering the success, wrong-password and mismatch cases.
